      How your care works

      Four steps, from your first visit to going home with a plan you can follow.

      1

      Assessment

      We listen to your story, examine your movement and measure your pain and function.

      2

      Clear plan

      You get a diagnosis in plain language, a goal and the number of sessions you are likely to need.

      3

      Treatment

      Hands-on therapy, exercise and, when useful, nutrition or cupping, adjusted at each visit.

      4

      Progress and home plan

      We re-measure your progress and give you a home exercise plan so results last.
